The overflowing toy bin might be why your toddler is "bored."

In a 2018 study, toddlers given 4 toys stuck with each one about twice as long, and played more creatively, than when they had 16.

You don't have to purge the playroom. Try toy rotation: put most toys away, bring out one bin at a time, and swap every week or two.

Before gift season, a kind ask for grandparents: one toy plus one experience, like a zoo day or a pancake date.
